name: complexity-optimizer
description: Universal complexity optimizer for AI coding agents. Scans codebases for O(n^2) loops, N+1 queries, sort-in-loop, membership checks, and render-path hotspots. Produces safe optimization reports.

plugins.name: complexity-optimizer
plugins.description: Analyze a codebase for algorithmic complexity hotspots and produce safe optimization reports. Finds nested loops, N+1 queries, sorts inside loops, .includes() instead of Set, and expensive render-path transforms. Report only by default — no files touched unless you ask.
